item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00145","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C03","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is the strongest reusable drafting template because the child repeats its distinctive tax-return list, identical temporal scope ('any period to and including 1954'), Eighty-fourth Congress limitation, authorized-subcommittee formulation, inspection machinery, reference to the two Treasury decisions approved May 3, 1955, and Federal Register effectiveness clause. C17 closely matches C10's current administrative framework but differs in its year formulation and offers no Judiciary-specific language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1954, shall, during the Eighty-fourth Congress","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1954, shall, during the Eighty-fourth Congress","explanation":"This is an essentially verbatim and materially specific definition of the covered returns and operative congressional period."},{"child_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 ... approved by me May 3, 1955","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the two Treasury decisions ... approved by me this date","explanation":"The child expressly invokes the two decisions issued with C10 on May 3, showing reuse of the same inspection machinery and closely parallel drafting."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The effectiveness clause is identical, reinforcing the broader textual and structural match."}]}
